summary: Feedback sheet puts thumbs up and thumbs down under an agent's answer. A thumbs down opens a short sheet where the person picks what went wrong from quick reasons, adds a note, and sends it, so the agent can do better next time.
use: When you want ratings on agent answers and the reasons behind the bad ones.
When feedback should be stored per project, like a memory of what the agent should avoid.
When a rating should cost one click and the longer form should only appear when something went wrong.
features: Thumbs up marks the answer as good and shows "Thanks, noted". Thumbs down opens the sheet and moves the cursor to the comment box once it has opened.
The sheet shows a `question` heading, toggleable `reasons` chips, a comment box and a `note` about who sees the feedback.
Send stays disabled until a reason is picked or something is written. `onSubmit` receives `{ reasons, comment }`, and if it returns a promise the button shows a spinner until it settles.
If `onSubmit` throws, the sheet stays open so the person can try again. On success it closes and a thank-you line appears, which you can change with `thanks`.
Cancel closes the sheet and clears the rating.
Rating, open state, picked reasons, comment and sent state can each be controlled or left to the component. `bare={false}` gives it a card of its own.
a11y: The thumbs are labelled "Good answer" and "Bad answer" and use `aria-pressed`.
Each reason chip is a toggle button with `aria-pressed`.
The Send button sets `aria-busy` while sending, and the thank-you line is a `role="status"` region.
While closed, the sheet is `inert` and `aria-hidden`.

faq.q: How do I save the feedback to my backend?
faq.a: Pass an async `onSubmit`. The component shows a spinner while the promise is pending and closes the sheet only when it resolves. If it rejects, the sheet stays open.

faq.q: Can I use my own reasons?
faq.a: Yes. Pass `reasons` as a list of strings. Pass an empty list to hide the chips and keep only the comment box.

faq.q: Does thumbs up open the sheet too?
faq.a: No. Thumbs up closes the sheet if it was open and shows a short thanks. Only thumbs down opens it, unless you control `open` yourself.
